horizon_algebra.conclusion: At actual black-to-move prefix,each safe score is -1-C+min(0,B);forced-loss move is -1-C+B. For B>0 the loss is strictly preferred;for B<=0 all three actions tie,with uniform-tie error1/3. This holds for ANY finite C and every real B in the admissible material score range. No linear material prices yield an entirely safe ideal D2maxset. The initial unsupported B<0-reversal inference is preserved and corrected:the opponent response changes when B changes sign. Source DRAW labels rely on the complete graph observer;the portable WIN proof establishes the bad-action loss separately.

horizon_signed.scope: D4 bounds hold for every material leaf score in the existing Model safety range,not arbitrary evaluators. D2 negative B changes opponent response:all three actions tie;it does not strictly prefer the safe actions. Deployed tie policy is checked separately in eight calls.
